feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 October 2026 4:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 26 October 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds, increasing to gales later, bringing a risk of severe gales.


##Synopsis##

A very deep area of low pressure will track north of the British Isles, sweeping associated frontal systems across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

SW 4 or 5, soon backing SE 6 or 7, veering S or SSW early afternoon. Increasing 7 or gale 8 through the evening, perhaps occasionally severe gale 9 early night, then veering SW overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough, then rough or very rough for a time later.


##Weather##

Rain at times.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

SW 7 or gale 8, decreasing WSW or SW 6 or 7.


##State of Sea##

Rough, becoming moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
